title: I Used the Bike-Cage Camera on the Neighbor Who Took My Labeled Pump

parts.text: I used the bike-cage camera at 7:21 p.m. after the neighbor took my labeled pump. The serial matched the still. I was thirty, renter, standing in a cage that made me look like I owned the wait. I photographed the empty hook, the label, and the still of a hand that was not mine. Management printed the still. The pump came back with the gauge still at their pressure. I keep the hook photo. The cage finally knows a label from a borrow.

social.video_title: The bike-cage camera caught my labeled pump leaving — Part 1/1
